headline: Asian Markets Rise Together, South Korea's Kospi Surges More Than 5%
summary: Asian stock markets advanced, led by South Korea's Kospi, which surged more than 5%. The rally was supported by a global rebound in technology shares.
why: The Kospi is South Korea's benchmark index, heavily weighted toward semiconductor and electronics makers. Its moves track global technology sentiment and chip demand.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The index jumped more than 5%, the largest move named in the regional rally.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The rally was led by South Korea's Kospi and supported by a global rebound in technology shares.
original_headline: Bursa Asia Kompak Menguat, Kospi Korea Selatan Melonjak Lebih dari 5%
